trustRootNote: Phase B (Gate 6B2C-R): runtime and CI verification use the published registry digest above. The resolved RepoDigests from docker image inspect must contain registryDigest before any candidate code runs. The mutable tag is retained for human reference only.

retiredMechanism.reason: Local Docker image .Id values are not portable across independent builders. A fresh GitHub-runner build produced a different final image .Id even with a digest-pinned base, because the image config JSON embeds a build timestamp. The registryDigest above is the sole active trust anchor.

resultChannelNote: Oracle writes result to stdout using function references saved before candidate import. File in /output is advisory only. Parent uses stdout sentinel for PASS/FAIL determination.
